smoke_gate.expansion_rule: Expand to the frozen eight-environment pilot only if runtime and receipt checks pass, at least one target environment passes locality, and the candidate is not redundant with action_dimension_anisotropy on all locality-admitted target comparisons.

selection_rationale: The r25 work orders request action_dimension_interaction for both push_rope and push_sand, so one probe can address two mechanism-specific coverage gaps.

The predecessor action_dimension_anisotropy is a diagonal per-dimension contrast perturbation, whereas this successor is an off-diagonal orthogonal rotation over frozen dimension pairs and therefore measures a mathematically distinct Jacobian direction.
The orthogonal rotation preserves each dimension's temporal mean and each paired subspace's centered energy, preventing response magnitude from being explained by global action amplification.
Probe selection uses work-order coverage, invariants, and algebraic non-equivalence only; no target-local primitive benefit label is used.
post_collection_rule: If the smoke gate admits expansion, collect the remaining six environments under the same campaign, build the atlas, replace only action_dimension_balancing's required path in the cumulative affinity, and rerun the unchanged selector plan, effect-label index, transfer certificate, and collision labels.
claim_boundary: This stage tests whether an off-diagonal action-coupling probe supplies missing local diagnostic coverage. It is not model-improvement evidence and cannot by itself establish selector superiority or transfer safety.
